## Policies

### Local documents are cited as secrets, never named in tracked files

`proposed` · `@exprim.privacy.private-document-references/1` · scope `all`

No tracked file, commit message or ledger record names a private local
document: not its path, its file name, its title, or the directory it
lives in. Where a document or directory must be referred to, register the
value with `akr secret put` and write the returned citation instead.
Published corpus manifests identify a private document by a neutral id
(`map-b`, `shading-a`), its size and its SHA-256 only.

Working notes (`dev-notes/`) and benchmark results (`docs/benchmarks/`)
stay on the machine, git-ignored: they describe private documents by
nickname, title and page image. Findings that should be public go into
this ledger or the changelog, with documents described by kind.

Files that need real paths at run time stay untracked:
`tools/render-probe/g0-corpus.local.json` and
`tools/render-bench/corpus.local.json`. Scripts take directories from
the environment or from those local files.

### Where CPU render time goes on dense vectors, tables and text (G0)

`verified` · `@exprim.renderer.attribution-20261110/2`

Measured on a 38-document corpus with stage timers, work counters and
sampled profiles (full report kept locally, not published):

- Dense map anchor: 72% of render time was tiling patterns. 60
  pattern-painted draws became 79,447 tile instances while 11% of the
  tiled pixels were visible through the draws' shapes.
- Clip masks: one page spent 96% of 4.3 s rasterizing 27.5 million rows
  to build 7,002 masks of about 6 KB each.
- Vector tables: 62% of render time was the compact kernel sweeping
  every interior cell of plain rectangles.
- Strokes and curves: every cubic takes 16 segments and every round join
  a 16-gon at every flattened vertex; on a stroke-heavy diagram 80% of
  edges are join disks and 97% of interior vertices are smooth.
- Text: a warm page is 56% glyph-cache lookup during lowering and 30%
  blits; through RenderSession 47% is RGBA to RGB packing.
- Compile is outside warm figures but is 36.5% of a first pass over
  table pages and 22.4% over text pages.
- After the G1 changes the map is 55% coverage kernel and 24% lowering;
  the tile cull test is 5.7%; about 10% of samples are under the
  allocator; libm rounding is 1.5% and trig 0.1%.

Absolute times drifted with machine load during the session; shares and
paired ratios are the reliable figures.

**supersedes** `@exprim.renderer.attribution-20261110/1`

## Evidence

### Nine-round paired release A/B of the three exact G1 changes

`verified` · `@exprim.renderer.g1-exact-speedups-ab/1`

Baseline 104f9d8 against c95ec54, release builds, process cycle time, nine
order-swapped rounds per case, identical page hashes in every case.
Dense map 271 ms to 132 ms (ratio 0.49, 9 of 9 rounds); the same through
RenderSession 0.48; clip-heavy page 2,609 ms to 200 ms (0.078); vector
tables 0.75; text 0.98 to 1.00; JPEG scan control 0.98; MRC scan control
1.02 (inside the 3% line, 2 of 9 rounds faster; re-run on an idle machine).
A/B hash gate against the baseline binary: 840 configurations, 0 differ.
Workspace tests: 1,228 passed, 0 failed.
